description: Search every installed server's tools by what they DO ("resize an image", "list pull requests") when you do not know which server has it. Ranks tool names and descriptions across loaded and unloaded servers from cache; nothing is loaded and no server is contacted. On a fresh install a no-match first waits (up to 20 s) for the startup scan still learning a server's tools. A match on a loaded server carries its full input schema; one on a never-loaded server carries name and description only -- `mcp_connect_read_tool` returns its arguments.

query.description: What the tool should DO, in plain words -- "create a github issue", "query postgres", "resize an image".

name: mcp_connect_find_tool
